title: Key facts (single source of truth)
description: Every figure that appears in more than one place on the site or in the AI system prompt. Nothing else may hard-code these values: content files and prose partials reference them with a {{fact:<id>}} token, which the build resolves. An unknown token is a build error. This file is the reason the refactor exists -- the September 2026 audit found the school budget, the village debt figure and the capital bond each living in 3-5 places with different values.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file, so editors validate on save.

facts.description: Unordered. Facts are looked up by id, never by position.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. This is the token name: id 'village-budget-fy2627' is written {{fact:village-budget-fy2627}} in any text field. Never rename without updating every reference -- the build will catch it if you forget.

category.description: Grouping only. Used to organise the generated system prompt and to let a human scan for related figures that ought to move together.

fact.description: Human-readable statement of WHAT this measures, independent of its value. e.g. 'PUFSD adopted budget, FY2026-27'. Shown in the generated system prompt and in review diffs.

value.description: Machine-readable value where one makes sense (98300000, 3.48, '2026-11-03'). Optional. Present so future arithmetic or charts never re-parse the display string. Null for facts that are purely textual.

display.description: The canonical rendered string -- '$98.3M'. This is what a {{fact:id}} token expands to. One string, so the hero stat, the issue card and the AI prompt cannot disagree about formatting.

qualifier.description: Any caveat that must travel with the number: 'voter-approved May 2026; levy rose 3.48%, at the state cap'. Kept separate so a card can show the bare figure while the AI prompt shows the full context. May contain {{fact:id}} tokens.

confidence.description: How firmly this figure is established, which controls the hedging language the generated prompt wraps it in. 'verified' = confirmed in an official document or adopted budget, state it plainly. 'reported' = covered by a vetted source but not confirmed in a primary record, so the prompt must attribute it and point the resident to the official source (the Pelham Middle School principal transition is the live example -- it appears in no processed meeting record). 'estimated' = a derived or approximate figure, must be presented as an estimate and never as a published percentage.

as_of.description: When the fact was TRUE (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Distinct from last_updated on purpose: the audit found three live village-debt figures ($15.1M, $17.88M, 'almost $18M') that were all defensible at different dates. Conflating the two is what let them drift.

last_updated.description: When a human last verified this against the source. Drives staleness warnings in the build.

supersedes.description: Id of the fact this replaces, e.g. 'school-budget-fy2526'. Makes the replacement of a stale figure explicit and reviewable rather than a silent overwrite. The superseded fact may stay in the file for historical reference.

caution.description: A negative instruction emitted immediately after this fact in the generated prompt, e.g. 'Do not state that a 5-2 vote occurred at any point in this process.' Exists so that guardrails correcting a known model error stay ATTACHED to the fact they guard: written into the hand-authored template instead, they outlive the figure they refer to and nobody remembers why they are there. When the fact is superseded or deleted, its caution goes with it.

in_prompt.description: Whether this fact is emitted into the generated ask-pelham.js system prompt. Set false for presentational figures the AI has no use for (e.g. a bar-chart width).

source.description: Where the number came from. Required -- an unsourced fact is exactly what this file exists to eliminate.

name.description: Publisher, e.g. 'Pelham Examiner' or 'Village of Pelham adopted budget'.

url.description: Direct link to the document or article.

used_in.description: GENERATED -- do not hand-edit. The build fills this in with every location that resolved a token for this fact, so you can see the blast radius of a change. Hand-written values are overwritten.
